text:
As a regular customer, I was really disappointed by the way paying customers were treated by the so-called “security” staff. This is not a criticism of the hardworking McDonald’s employees, who were absolutely fine, and provided great service.

After collecting my order I briefly checked all items ordered were present in the bag which is something any reasonable person would do. I was told this was not allowed, as it was “policy” for customers to leave immediately after collecting food. This was in an extremely patronising manner by “security” as if I had done something wrong. I was then herded out of the establishment like cattle.

I noted security swearing and threatening physical violence against other paying customers to get them vacate despite still waiting for food. These people had also done absolutely nothing wrong and I felt the environment was extremely hostile and unnecessary.

I think it’s clear these “security” enjoy their power trip and it’s frankly embarrassing for the establishment to allow it to continue.
author: Dan B

text: I gave you 1 star because I couldn’t give you 0 for service. I rang up to ask for advice because the order was missing half the phone. The manager answered the phone, I politely asked for advice and then the manager hung up the phone. He answered the phone quickly the first time and then didn’t respond to multiple calls made after it. The phone sounds like it’s being ignored. I understand business but it was plainly rude. All the remaining food became cold. It was under the name sinead on uber eats and was made today at 12. Very unhappy customer.
author: Amy G

text: Extremely rude security staff in the evenings. Swearing at customers and deliberately trying to provoke reactions while smirking/laughing. A member of our party has a toilet access card (“can’t wait card”) due to a chronic urological disability however we were sworn at and told to leave for asking to use the toilets (despite having paid for three meals). I understand the need to close the toilets on busy evenings however I am surprised to see such little compassion and discretion towards those with disabilities.
author: Derry Kochar

text:
Good morning,
I visited the establishment this morning to purchase breakfast using a voucher. After waiting for a few minutes, I attracted the attention of a manager. Upon inspecting my voucher, he examined the date and stated, "No long."
He proceeded to serve my order along with a drink. When it became apparent that the voucher did not cover the entire cost, I paid the remaining amount at his insistence.
What kind of manager is that!!!!
author: miguel marciano

text:
MASSIVE FLY PROBLEM!

I visited this McDonalds on 01/12/25 and as soon as I walked to the seating area upstairs I was greeted with so many flies. As soon as I sat down they began buzzing around and flying on the table I was sat on. Having looked around the upstairs area they were literally everywhere. Absolutely foul and needs to be sorted ASAP! I left not long after as I couldn’t bare it.
author: A M

text: Took 30-40 minutes just to get a burger and fries while the place was rammed and in absolute chaos. Not faulting the staff - they simply don't have the time or manpower to handle the workload. Company needs to stop prioritising Uber orders and get its act together. Absolute shambles.
author: Linton Ineson

text: I ordered a Mc Delivery Cheeseburger meal at around 2am this morning. I requested no ketchup or mustard which was fine. What I didn't request was a cheeseburger with no burger. I mean, is this some sort of joke or something? What an absolute sham.
author: Jim Dovey
